response.sql: WITH matched_scans AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, sc.pressratio, si.riskeval FROM scans sc INNER JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_scans FROM matched_scans), grouped AS (SELECT matched_scans.zoneref, matched_scans.riskeval, AVG(matched_scans.pressratio) as avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) as num_scans, totals.total_scans FROM matched_scans, totals GROUP BY matched_scans.zoneref, matched_scans.riskeval) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_compression_ratio, num_scans, CAST(num_scans AS REAL) / total_scans as share FROM grouped ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
